s: Kamma dinim peratiyyim hannohagim beshabbat ubo y"a seipim: en rokebin al gabbe behema, gezera shemma yachtok zemora lehanhigah, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"h. Veen shatin al pene hammayim, gezera shemma yaaseh chabit shel shayyatin, dehaynu keli shel guma sheoregin oto veosim kemin chabit arukka ulemedin lashut bo. Bammeh debarim amurim? Benahar, abal bikli — muttar, sheen derek laasot chabit lashut bah bikli. Abal bibreka shebbechatzer — asur, mippene shekkeshehammayim neeqarim kesheshshat — hare hem yotzeim chutz labbereka, vahare zeh domeh lenahar. Veim yesh lah sapa sabib — muttar lashut bah, sheapillu neeqru hammayim — hassapa machazeret otam limqomam, vahare zeh domeh likli:

En mesappeqin kap al yarek, veen metappechin kap el kap, ben lesimcha, apillu benissuin, ben leebel, gezera shemma yetaqqen kele shir leshorer o leqonen, ella im ken mesappeq umetappeach kilachar yad. Apillu lehakkot beetzba al haqqarqa o al halluach, o achat keneged achat kederek hamshorerim, kegon ellu shemmakkin beamma al haggudal veosin bezeh tenuot arebot, o leqashqesh beegoz letinoq o lesacheq bezug kede sheyyishtoq — kol zeh vekayyotze bo asur, gezera shemma yetaqqen kele shir. Veken asur leraqqed mittaam zeh, apillu benissuin. Abal besimchat tora muttar leraqqed beshaa sheomerim qillusim lattora, mishshum kebod hattora. Veakshav shennahagu hehamon lesappeq uletappeach uleraqqed bekol mine simcha — en mochin beyadam, lepi shebbevadday lo yishmeu, umutab sheyyihyu shogegim veal yihyu mezidim. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut lomar, sheakshav en anu beqiim baasiyyat kele shir, velo shayyak ligzor shemma yetaqqen kele shir, sheddabar sheeno matzuy hu kelal:

En danin dine mamonot, gezera shemma yiktebu. Veen oneshin beshabbat. Velaken asur litpos ulehaknis lebet hassohar mi shennitchayyeb ezeh onesh kede shello yibrach, vekol shekken sheasur lehalqoto (shezzehu biklal din). Veim yibrach — en alenu kelum. Veen mesadderin teanot beshabbat, abal liqbol ulehatztzia debarim, kegon al taanot betulim — muttar, kemo sheyyitbaer beeben haezer simman s"b. Vetiqqen rabbenu gereshom meor haggola shello lebattel hattamid beshabbat, im lo bishbil taanot haqqahal. Veasur liqboa maqom lachalitza, mippene shennireh keillu yoshebim ladun:

En meqaddeshin et haishsha, velo choletzin, velo megorshin, gezera shemma yiktob. Ushekib mera shettaqap alayv hacholi verotzeh legaresh ishto kede shello tizzaqeq leyibbum — hittiru lo legaresh beshabbat, al derek sheyyitbaer beeben haezer simman ql"v, kede shello titrop dato alayv im lo yaasu retzono:

Veken en meyabbemin, velo konesin ishsha lechuppa, apillu qiddeshah mibbeod yom, mippene sheal yede kak qoneh otah leyorshah, veasur liqnot qinyan beshabbat, mippene shehu biklal gezerat miqqach umimkar, sheggazeru mishshum shemma yiktob, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"v. Veyesh mattirim leqaddesh veliknos lemi sheen lo ishsha ubanim, mishshum mitzvat periyya urebiyya. Veap sheen zeh iqqar, mikkol maqom somekin al zeh bishat haddechaq, ki gadol kebod habberiyyot, kemo shergilin shellipamim shello hayu yekolim lehashvot im hanneduneya beyom v' ad hallayla veosin hachuppa vehaqqiddushin belel shabbat hoil ukebar hukenu lisudda ulenissuin, vehaya biyyush lakkalla velechatan im lo yiknos az. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tzarik lizzaher shello yabo lide kak, vekamma aberot bain mimmah shemmeacharim hachuppa. Vekol yere shamayim yachmir leatzmo shello laasot kelal nissuin beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer beeben haezer simman s"b:

Veken en maarikin, velo maqdishin, velo macharimin shum dabar legaboah, mippene sheddomeh lemiqqach umimkar, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"v. Veken en podin et habben, apillu bikli sheshshaveh Hashem selaim, mippene sheddomeh lemiqqach umimkar. Veen lo litten hammaot lekohen beereb shabbat, lepi sheaz lo yukal lebarek, shekkevan sheadayin lo chala alayv hammitzva — ek yomar "vetzivvanu", ubeshabbat shehu zemannah gam ken lo yukal lebarek, kevan sheaz eno oseh kelum, laken yamtin ad yom a' beshabbat. Vaapillu im kalu lo k"t y"b tshtz"g beyom v' shehu chodesh — lo yipdehu beyom v', lepi shechodesh shebbattora hu sheloshim yamim shelemim, velaken tzarik sheyyaggia leyom l"a bishat happidyon:

Veen maprishin terumot umaasrot, mippene shehu kimtaqqen dabar shello haya metuqqan. Vekullan shennaasu beshabbat, ben shogegin, ben mezidin, ben mutin — mah sheasu asuy. Ella sheim hiprish terumot umaasrot bemezid — lo yokal mizzeh bo bayyom, lo hu velo acherim, kedin haoseh kol dabar haasur middibre soperim bemezid sheasur lehanot mimmennu apillu laacherim ad lemotzae shabbat, ubemotzae shabbat muttar miyyad apillu lo, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"ch:

Hakkones et haalmana — lo yabo aleha bia rishona lo beshabbat velo beyom tob, lepi sheen chuppa lealmana liqnotah al yede kak, ella al yede bia o al yede yichud harauy lebia hu sheqqoneh otah, veen qonin qinyan beshabbat. Vaapillu im nesaah belel h' venityachada immo kebar yichud harauy lebia — tob lehachamir shello labo aleha bia rishona beshabbat o yom tob, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheyyichud hu hanniqra chuppa velo chuppa shellanu, veen chuppa lealmana, ella al yede bia bilbad hu sheqqoneh otah. Vekol shekken im hayeta temea belel h' venityachada immo al yede b' shomerim, sheen zeh yichud harauy lebia, veeno qoneh bealmana apillu lepi sebara harishona. Velaken en lah litbol belel shabbat. Veim mutteret litbol bemotzae shabbat — yitbaer beyoreh dea simman qtz"z. Vegam bibtula shechuppa qona bah — yesh leyachadan achar hachuppa yichud gamur harauy lebia qodem hashshabbat, o lo yityachadu yichud gamur kol hashshabbat kullah, kede lachush lisbara haacharona sheyyichud gamur hu hanniqra chuppa velo chuppa shellanu, veasur laasoto bitchilla beshabbat, veken beyom tob:

Asur leadam lehashit dabar benahar leholiko meetzlo o lahabio etzlo, mippene shezzehu gam ken biklal haggezera sheggazeru shello lashut beshabbat. Velaken, qesamim sheal pene hammayim — asur lehaptzilan lekan ulekan kede lenaqqot hammayim sheyyihyu yapim. Vekol zeh benahar, abal bikli o bibreka sheyyesh lah sapa — lo gazeru kelal, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Sepina, im hi yoshebet beqarqa hayyam mammash veenah shata kelal — muttar likkanes bah. Veim lav — asur, ella im ken niknas letokah mibbeod yom, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"ch. Veim hi qeshura keminhag hassepinot haomedot benamal, ap al pi shehi shata al pene hammayim — muttar likkanes bah. Vetzarik sheyyehe [qeresh] qashur berosho haechad bassepina ubashsheni bayyabbasha:

Sepina haomedet beqarqa hannahar — asur lehaarim likkanes lishan betoka veyodea shehannokri yolikenna leeber hashsheni, vetalmid chakam muttar lo lehaarim bekak. Veakshav en lanu talmide chakamim leinyan zeh, ayyen simman shy"d:
